criterion.primary: Browser monotonic file-input event to sequenced post-UI completion; release package, fresh profile and unchanged production defaults.
criterion.target: At least 5% median paired reduction against both A and byte-identical C, at least five of six faster pairs, and equal-work change <=0% against each control on each independently scheduled host.
criterion.nonTarget: No more than 3% median paired regression against either control on either host. Report every fixed observation, including failed screens.
criterion.correctness: Existing strict qualification_receipts binds each raw report to source, package, fixture, browser, harness, complete import boundary, output digest, all 72 lookup results, restart and exact normalized OPFS file sizes. Separate exhaustive A/B media must agree.
criterion.observations: Three warmups, six balanced ABC blocks, then separate full-media A/B per host. Stop on the first invalid observation. No exclusions, replacement observations, pooling hosts or statistics on incomplete/invalid cohorts.
criterion.memory: Separate prospectively fixed ABBA on host 0 and BAAB on host 1, only after ordinary observations. Existing import-window process-tree PSS/private helpers and raw scan audit; each metric median paired change <=5% and worst pair <=10%. No sampled timing enters ordinary comparison.
criterion.storage: VNDB active SAH allocation fixed prospectively at37 4096-byte units from both current-baseline diagnostic receipts. Random SAH and media-generation basenames alone normalize; exact per-file sizes still match across every observation.
criterion.control: Report all six C/A paired changes, median, equal-work and worst pair on each host. Interpret both B/control effects alongside this identical-code run-order drift; never pool hosts.
criterion.treatmentPresence: For every JMdict observation, preserve existing raw source eligibility and lookup-index worker-file count. Exact53-bank171617523-byte sub1GiB source and A/C count0, B count>=1 are required; inactive or missing treatment cannot qualify.

derivation.admission: Exact approved source/tree, complete source/package allowlists, changed-member digests and full package/harness inventories are bound before acquisition. Missing source or full-inventory bindings fail before any external runner command.
